title: Verify metrics sidecar integrity on merged branch (host-gpu-vram-monitoring)
objective: After the merge completes, validate that all pieces of the host-metrics stack are correctly wired together: metrics service in compose.yaml (healthcheck, networks, bind mounts), agent/metrics/gather.py (ring buffer + /history endpoint), opencode v2 plugin registration (get_host_metrics tool + host-metrics-tui plugin), Dockerfile bake ordering, and verify-metrics.sh integration. This is a verification ticket — if any piece is broken by the merge, it becomes an implementation subtask.

subtickets.title: Audit compose.yaml for metrics service (healthcheck, networks, mounts)
subtickets.objective: Verify: metrics binds to 0.0.0.0 on port 19532, has no ports published to host, is on the internal network only (not egress), mount paths match gather.py constants (/host/proc, /host/hwmon, /host/thermal, /sys/class/dmi/id). After merge, check if compose.yaml had any conflict markers or if main's version was auto-accepted.

subtickets.title: Verify Dockerfile COPY lines for all three plugin directories
subtickets.objective: Confirm: agent/opencode/plugins/little-mester-logo/, host-metrics/, and host-metrics-tui/ are all baked into /etc/opencode/plugins/. Confirm OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT env var lists plugins in the correct v2 format (no OPENCODE_TUI_CONFIG). Confirm OPENCODE_CONFIG points to /etc/opencode/opencode/opencode.json.

subtickets.title: Verify openconfig.json has both plugins listed
subtickets.objective: Check agent/podencode/podencode.json (or wherever it's generated): host-metrics plugin should be in the servers/plugins array (for get_host_metrics tool). Host-metrics-tui should be in cli.json or OPENCODE_CLI_CONFIG_CONTENT.

subtickets.title: Validate verify-metrics.sh works against Docker network
subtickets.objective: The script runs a client container attached to the compose internal network and curls http://metrics:19532/summary. Check it still works post-merge. If broken (wrong hostname, port changed), fix.

subtickets.title: Verify metrics sidecar DDEcision section in DECISIONS.md J.7 complete
subtickets.objective: Ensure docs/DECISIONS.md J.7 and J.8 are accurate after merge: the ring buffer (500ms), the /history endpoint, the 0.0.0.0 binding in container netns, the verify-metrics.sh approach.

notes: Linked to ticket-011 (board/dashboard sparkline) since metrics sidecar is its data source. Supersedes legacy ticket-legacy-10 — this new ticket covers the same scope in v1 schema format. This must be verified on a host with NVIDIA GPU; container-only verification is config-level only.

acceptance_criteria.text: compose.yaml wires the metrics service with healthcheck, networks, and read-only mounts.
gather.py exposes the ring buffer and /history endpoint.
The v2 plugin registration exposes get_host_metrics and the TUI plugin.
Dockerfile bake ordering preserves the metrics files.
verify-metrics.sh passes against the merged branch.
